answer: Freight desks used to print 36 open-water courier licenses from one office chair. A courier now locks 18,000 units in a 14-day vault, steams a 42-kilometer measured ocean transect, and seats a tagged sinker at a charted canyon mouth. Three independent skippers must match the sinker's sonar hash to the vault lock before the license prints. If the sinker is absent or the vault opens early, 70 percent of the bond is slashed and the ticket is void.
